test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: An article was sold at a loss of 14%. If it was sold for Rs. 756 more, then there would have been a gain of 7%. Find the cost price of the article.
solution:
**Given:**

Loss% = 14%

**Formula used:**

Selling price (S.P) = Cost price (C.P) - {Cost price (C.P) × (100 ± P/L)%}

**Calculation:**

The article sold at a loss of 14%.

C.P : S.P = 100 : 86

If the article will be sold at a profit of 7%.

C.P : S.P = 100 : 107

Now,

Difference of S.P = 756

⇒ (107 - 86) units = 756

⇒ 21 units = 756

⇒ 1 unit = Rs.36

⇒ 100 units = 36 × 100 = Rs.3600

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.3600.**
